title: PackedInt32Array in subResource not loaded (empty) on Android
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7080) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1255U (12 threads) - 31.69 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have a tres ; which includes a sub Resource.
this sub resource do include a PackedInt32Array (filled up)
Once on Android ; this sub ressource packed is empty

Replaced with coma separated String works like a charm


### Steps to reproduce

[sub_resource type="Resource" id="Resource_y5naq"]
script = ExtResource("11_yh0gj")
col = 14
row = 1
target_level = "02_number_arrows.tres"
field_packed_str = ""
reveal_packed_str = "14,2,13,3,12,3,11,4,12,4"  <= Not loaded when was PackedInt32Array

[resource]
script = ExtResource("7_a77v2")
is_overworld = true
is_hexa = true
is_peaceful = true
width = 17
height = 12
floor_packed = PackedInt32Array(12, 0)
water_packed = PackedInt32Array()

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-bug-repro-packedarray-subresource.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31235415/godot-bug-repro-packedarray-subresource.zip)
